description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_DataSelector_Values' that extends 'Image_Graph_DataSelector'. It provides functionality to filter data based on specified values, used in the context of data selection for graph rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_Values
classes.description: A class that filters data to include only specified values, for use in graph data selection.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_Values
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an array of values to filter.

methods.name: setValueArray
methods.description: Setter method to update the array of values used for filtering.

methods.name: _select
methods.description: Private method to determine if provided values should be selected based on the filter.
